interface Field {
  "#value": string;
}
class Field {
  #value = 1;
  ["#value"] = "public";
  read() { return this.#value; }
}

interface Method {
  "#value"(): string;
}
class Method {
  #value = 2;
  ["#value"]() { return "call"; }
  read() { return this.#value; }
}

const field = new Field();
const method = new Method();
console.log(field.read(), field["#value"], method.read(), method["#value"]());
